summary: [spec fidelity + standards] A default the help promises in prose is not in the document for three options: `skills install --providers` (help: "Omitted: canon.yaml `skills.providers`, else the install lock's providers, else the detected .claude/.codex/.omp/.pi directories"), and `skills check --providers` and `skills doctor --providers` ("Omitted: as for install"). Each has default null and no defaultNote, but spec 10.7.3 ("A default the help text promises MUST appear here") and the brief (F3/F6: every default --help promises is carried; a computed one is null + defaultNote) require a defaultNote. Cause: the detector in atip_schemadoc_05_help_defaults... (crates/canon-cli/tests/schema_doc.rs:490) looks only for "(default", "defaults to", "default is", "default:", "[default", so the word "Omitted" slips past it, and DEFAULT_NOTES (spec.rs:130) has rows for skills-source but none for providers. Fix: add `("skills install"|"skills check"|"skills doctor", "providers", note)` rows and widen the detector (or state the rule on a closed list of phrasings the test checks against the help text). Blast radius: my scan of all 608 option helps found no other prose default without a note; the guides generated from the spec are unaffected.
